headline: Google admits some Android apps run poorly on Intel-based Googlebooks
summary: Google has acknowledged that some Android apps, those not optimized for Intel's x86-64 architecture, run poorly or have issues on its Intel-based Googlebook laptops, despite previously emphasizing full Play Store library access on the Android-based devices.

claims.statement: Google acknowledged that some Android apps run poorly or have issues on Intel-based Googlebooks.
